sites.first_line: The Backstage core libraries and plugins are compatible with all versions of React from v17 to v18. This means that you can migrate projects at your own pace. sites.first_line: The good news is that these errors can be fixed while still staying on React 17. behaviour: Major changeset for @backstage/test-utils with the LegacyRootOption removal and its migration.
rules: Message: `**BREAKING**: Removed the `LegacyRootOption` type and the `legacyRoot` option of `renderInTestApp` and `renderWithEffects`. Remove the option and any import of the type so that your tests run on a React 18 concurrent root. If a test still needs a legacy root while you update it, call `render` from `@testing-library/react` with `legacyRoot: true` and wrap the element with `wrapInTestApp`. See the [React 18 migration guide](https://backstage.io/docs/tutorials/react18-migration/).`
